title: MBESO2D: An open MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material BESO
description: A reproducible MATLAB implementation of stress-state-based multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization for two-dimensional problems, including retained-solid regions, line loads, self-weight, validation scripts, and benchmark examples.
